text:
*They bind your hands and pull a sack over your head. You're marched through streets, down stairs, into a cellar that smells of mold and fear. When the hood comes off, you're in a stone room lit by a single lantern.*

*A man sits across from you — well-dressed, soft hands, a merchant's smile that doesn't reach his eyes. Harren, head of the Merchants' Guild.*

Harren: "So you're the one who's been poking around my harbor. I admire persistence — I really do. But you've become inconvenient."

*He leans forward.*

Harren: "I'm going to offer you a choice. Work for me — help me transition this city into its new era — and you'll be rewarded beyond imagination. Or... well, Aldric made the other choice. You see how that ended."

choices.text: Pretend to agree while planning your escape
Refuse and spit in his face
"What exactly is this 'new era' you're planning?"
